44.text: Welcome to Willy's Junkyard!Build your own junk jumper by buying a body, wheels, and engine from parts that Willy has in his junkyard.Once you finish your creation, it's time to jump it!  Once on the track, hold down the space bar to give your junk jumper gas, and try to safely jump over the piles of garbage.  But be careful not to blow your engine or crash into the trash!  After six successful jumps, you can retire in style!
